biography: Charlie Blasingame is a journalist based in New York City, currently studying Journalism + Design with a minor in politics at The New School. She works on the news desk of the [New School Free Press] (https://www.newschoolfreepress.com/) and serves as a student researcher for the United Nations DPPA AI Innovation Cell through a partnership with The New School. With a background in fine art, she is drawn to storytelling of many kinds and is particularly interested in stories at the intersection of art, culture, and politics. She has worked as a freelance journalist with by-lines in publications including [Out in STL] (https://outinstl.com/) and the [New School Free Press] (https://www.newschoolfreepress.com/), and completed an editorial internship at her award-winning hometown magazine, [St. Louis Magazine](https://www.stlmag.com/), where she covered everything from local art gallery shows and community initiatives to local artists' groundbreaking involvement in the World Cup.
